candidate.subject: Corvus corax
candidate.title: Before I go
candidate.body:
Picked the roof to make myself heard. Called until the sun had me breathing with my bill open.

A tree below had shade. I could reach it before the next call.

Opened my bill wider for that one. Took another breath instead.

Still up here. I want to leave on a louder noise.

candidate.visibleScene: A raven stands on a shingled roof ridge beside a rusted pipe, bill open and throat feathers raised. One foot reaches forward along the ridge; no alternating-foot sequence is claimed.
candidate.fictionBoundary: Roof choice, earlier calls, fictional warm weather, panting, shaded tree outside the frame and desire for a final louder call are invented. The source describes playful clucking while puffing, not observed thermal stress. A bill-open still cannot diagnose panting. This is an illustrative calling posture supporting a fictional sequence, not a factual account of the photographed individual.
candidate.authorAssessment: Candidate for independent prose review. The payoff is the conflict between wanting to depart and wanting the final call to be bigger; instead of ending, she breathes and remains. No answering voice, echo, imagined recipient or audience embarrassment. No feet alternation, avoiding Finch87. No lesson or aphorism.

privateAlternatives.title: Hot ridge
privateAlternatives.body: Chose the roof to call from. Felt the warmth through my feet and called louder. Lifted one foot. Called. Changed feet. Called. There was shade in the tree. I could have finished there. Made it halfway through the next call before both feet wanted to leave.
privateAlternatives.assessment: Too close to Finch87 alternating feet at a shade boundary. Specific hot-roof foot response lacks direct species evidence in the bounded search. Retired, not candidate.

privateAlternatives.title: An unfinished performance
privateAlternatives.body: I wanted the whole clearing to hear me. Chose the roof. Put everything into the first call. By the fifth, I was hot enough to keep my bill open between them. Tried one more. Had to stop halfway through and breathe. The next one could wait. I stayed where it would come from.
privateAlternatives.assessment: More solemn and measured than Maud. Closing location statement explains commitment without enough comic appetite. Removed numerical call tally and strengthened the stubborn desire in selected prose.
